race.comment: BLUISH HUE (4) last appeared four weeks ago when he broke through for a well-deserved win in a 1500m Rosehill Highway, coming from worse than midfield on straightening. Yet to race over the mile but gets a soft run out of gate two and Nash will squeeze every drop out of him. GUY'S LAST PRIZE (6) is a progressive five-year-old who registered a third win from four runs this prep when a narrow victor over this distance at Goulburn last time out. All his form is on wet tracks so these conditions present a new challenge, but he deserves the benefit of the doubt. OLYMPIAN (2) started warm favourite and looked to have his chance but found a couple better first-up at Newcastle. Beaten under a length in the Carbine Club here at this trip last prep which is an excellent form reference. OCEAN TSUNAMI (7) met with good support but had no luck first-up a fortnight ago at Rosehill. Good enough to test this field. SNOWY (11) is going okay and is a lightweight one for the exotics.
